# maps/combat_arena.gd

[Source:1](../../../../maps/combat_arena.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Combat practice scene with wave encounters, weapons and environmental hazards.
Owns encounter resets and navigation; actors use the normal gameplay systems.
Controls and station layout are documented in maps/COMBAT_PRACTICE.md.

Base: `Node3D`. Registered class: `none`.
